scope: Pre-run primary-source overlap check for candidate42, not exhaustive novelty verification

papers.title: Localization Distillation for Object Detection
papers.source: Paper Search arXiv metadata and download tools, version dated2022-12-08
papers.reviewed: Abstract, introduction and sections3.5-3.6: GT-based main/valuable localization regions and selective logit distillation
papers.overlap: Native localization outputs contain useful information outside ordinary positive/classification locations. This principle and dense localization supervision are not new.
papers.difference_and_limit: Candidate42 uses no teacher/student training: fixed immediate-grid box differences and a spatial-slot shuffle test for continuous coordinate error. This implementation difference alone does not establish novelty. No faithful LD reproduction or superiority claim.

papers.title: Automated Model Evaluation for Object Detection via Prediction Consistency and Reliability
papers.source: Paper Search arXiv metadata and download tools, version dated2025-10-02
papers.reviewed: Abstract, introduction and beginning of3.1: merged pre-NMS predictions, spatial consistency and confidence-based reliability for unlabeled AutoEval
papers.overlap: Obtaining localization reliability from many already-computed overlapping pre-NMS boxes is established. It is not novel to reuse discarded predictions or compare box agreement.
papers.difference_and_limit: PCR estimates detector performance rather than refining boxes. Candidate42 checks fixed native-grid direction order against ordinary unordered controls; no claim that an ordered field is absent from all earlier work.

known_overlap: KL-Loss variance voting, BorderDet boundary features and SABL side-specific localization already cover neighboring-box fusion and border-specific information. Neither an MLP nor a spatial tensor can be claimed as a contribution.
